description: An oil-painted interior of a timber-and-stone workshop. A man in a dark fur-trimmed coat and black beret holds a printed sheet by a leaded window. Beside a large wooden screw press, a young worker in an apron inks type with two leather balls. Another man works at the far right, and printed sheets hang on cords from the rafters. Type cases and stacked paper sit on shelves. The look is late medieval or early modern.
